name: Unfair Flips
desc:
🎲This is a non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you.
Starting with just a 25% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

✨Updates
- New Gem currency for end game progression
- You can now skip the Card menu
- More free rewards in the Rewards menu
- Bug fixes

This game is inspired by the Steam game Unfair Flips.
We do not use any assets from the original game.
